title: The ranch house
logline: Gully's half-acre of hemlock. Wood visits. The strip is very quiet about how it feels.

panels.composition: A small ranch house on a half-acre, hemlocks all round, a gravel drive, a flatbed. GULLY on the porch. MARIA in the window. WOOD and BARNABY arriving on foot.

image.prompt: a small ranch house on a half-acre among hemlock trees, a gravel drive with a flatbed truck, a stocky man on the porch, a woman in the window, a thin man and a gray-muzzled dog arriving on foot, muddy watercolor

panels.composition: The kitchen. A real table. Maria setting down three plates. Chowder. A fourth bowl, on the floor, for the dog.

balloons.text: He gets the bowl. You get the chair.
I've never had a chair here.

image.prompt: a small kitchen with three plates of chowder on a real table and a fourth bowl on the floor for a dog, a practical woman setting them down

panels.composition: Wood at the table. Looking at the room: curtains, a calendar, a photo of the dock wedding already framed — in cedar. His frame. He recognizes the cut.

image.prompt: close-up of a thin man at a kitchen table looking at a framed wedding photograph on the wall in a plain cedar frame, recognizing it, no words
image.notes: His frame. He cut it. The strip lets him notice.

panels.composition: After. The porch. Gully and Wood. The hemlocks. Maria's shape in the window doing dishes. The dog asleep on the porch boards. Nobody says the thing.

image.prompt: two men sitting on a ranch-house porch at dusk among hemlocks, a woman's shape in the lit kitchen window, a dog asleep on the boards, watercolor, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Gully's house. His frame on their wall. The strip is quiet.
